integrity: Analytical proof of general trace word identity; deterministic finite checker included and run; numerical experiments are not a substitute for the proof.
scientific_limitations: Finite directed cycles and even-integer Schatten moments only; no extension to noninteger exponents, general graphs, or an independent priority certification. Some low-dimensional instances are known in earlier specialized analyses. Full text of an older ordinary-numerical-radius article was not inspected.
title: First flux-sensitive Schatten moments of weighted directed cycles
